snippet.title: Maneater 2 - Reveal Trailer | Coming 2027
snippet.description:
The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom—an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

Coming 2027 to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2!

Wishlist today!
